title: Playing for visiting opera and Pavlova's ballet
summary: The New York opera company and Pavlova's ballet visited San Juan, and his uncle slipped him into the trombone section even though he was still learning.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: Oh, for the opera. When the opera came, was that an opera company from Puerto Rico or from the States?
No, from New York. The regular opera company, like with Anna Pavlova and things like that -- oh, they came from New York. The best, and the best directors, and so forth.
So you played also for the ballet?

Well, yeah; a little bit. But I mean, I was way down there -- the trombone; I was not a first trombone then, you know? I was learning. But my uncle just put me in there because he thought I could make it.
